purpose: Documentation-only preservation of the human-supplied ARGUS PASS and selected original native receipts; no new independent application review.
source_access: read-only; exact report and top-level selected receipts only; no historical clone or benchmark archive

originals.interpretation: Supplied final ARGUS PASS; unedited historical claims and qualifications.
Complete initial Windows output: 553 passed, 5 skipped, 4 timeout failures; includes EBUSY cleanup diagnostic.
Complete available targeted rerun output: 5 passed, 30-second test timeout as reported by ARGUS.
Existing zero-byte output; exit 0 is reported in verdict/setup notes, not independently encoded in this file.
Turbopack success output; exit 0 is reported in verdict/setup notes, with no standalone exit marker in this file.
Partial preliminary capture with 3 failed route cases and native warnings; no final totals, complete command, or exit marker. Not a full-suite or successful rerun receipt.
Original setup/final-result notes; resolved checkout operations and historical bundler wording retained unchanged.

separate_committed_ava_references.interpretation: Separate AVA Webpack success; committed command output is next build --webpack. Not an ARGUS run.
Separate AVA Linux full suite: 562 passed / 26 files. Not full Windows green.

availability_limits: The final verdict, full-suite log, targeted rerun log, typecheck file, and build file are present and preserved.

typecheck.txt is available but empty; no machine-readable exit-status receipt was available among inspected review-directory/top-level files. Exit 0 for type/build is attributed to ARGUS verdict/setup notes.
out-test.txt is a partial preliminary capture, not a complete alternative full-suite result; its exact complete invocation and final outcome are unavailable in that file.
A full 562-passed Windows rerun receipt is unavailable among the supplied selected outputs; none is claimed or fabricated.
Independent ARGUS browser rerun receipts are unavailable because ARGUS explicitly did not independently rerun those checks.
Delivery restart/status notices are operational chatter, not application failures; no transcript is reconstructed or copied.

publication_screening.scope: All seven selected original report/log files, decoded for inspection but copied without transformation.
publication_screening.qualification: Targeted pattern screening and receipt inspection, not an exhaustive secret-free certification. Synthetic fixture secrets and example database URLs are test data. No secret values are emitted by the scan.

preservation.transformation: none; raw bytes copied, including BOMs, native newlines, empty file, and existing mojibake
preservation.git_protection: Archive-local .gitattributes disables text conversion, filters, ident, and inherited encoding/eol attributes for each original.
preservation.checksums: SHA256SUMS covers all archive files except itself and also the summary. Manifest records source/archive equality; manifest does not hash itself.
